title: THE ROLE OF TASK COMPLEXITY IN REDUCING AI PLAGIARISM: A STUDY OF GENERATIVE AI TOOLS
reasoning: The study focuses on academic integrity and the use of generative AI (specifically ChatGPT) in the context of student plagiarism. While it discusses 'ethical judgment' and 'plagiarism ethics' as they relate to academic misconduct and educational pedagogy, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, morals, or general ethical frameworks.
